name: Ceremora
tagline: The operating system for the modern wedding enterprise.
positioning: Ceremora unifies every contract, timeline, and vendor handoff into one command layer built for high-volume wedding businesses.

hero.sub: Ceremora replaces the spreadsheet sprawl running your studio — contracts, deposits, day-of timelines, and vendor handoffs orchestrated as a single system of record built for scale.

features.title: Contract-to-cash pipeline
features.description: Turn a signed proposal into a funded booking automatically. Deposits, payment schedules, and cancellation clauses enforce themselves.

features.title: Day-of orchestration
features.description: Publish one master timeline and every photographer, planner, and caterer sees their exact cues. No group text at 6am.

features.title: Vendor network ledger
features.description: Track referrals, kickbacks, and preferred-partner performance across thousands of events in a single auditable ledger.

features.title: Enterprise access control
features.description: SSO, role-based permissions, and full audit trails so a 200-planner franchise runs on one governed instance.

features.title: Portfolio-wide analytics
features.description: See booking velocity, average event value, and seasonal load across every studio location in real time.

features.title: Client concierge portal
features.description: Give couples a branded portal for approvals, payments, and shared timelines — every touch logged against the record.

testimonials.quote: We consolidated eleven studios onto Ceremora in a quarter. The vendor ledger alone recovered six figures in untracked referral revenue we didn't know we were losing.
testimonials.name: Marisol Devane

testimonials.quote: Our day-of coordination used to live in three tools and a prayer. Now the timeline is the system of record and every vendor moves in lockstep. It changed how we scale.
testimonials.name: Theo Brandt

testimonials.quote: As a national franchise we needed real governance, not a glorified spreadsheet. Ceremora gave us SSO, audit trails, and portfolio analytics on day one.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For growing studios ready to retire the spreadsheet.
For multi-location operators scaling across markets.
For franchises and groups running at national scale.

homepage.footerBlurb: Ceremora is the command layer for wedding businesses that intend to dominate their market. Built for scale. Governed by design.
